description: ledger_signer is cp1's genuine signer address with a trailing newline appended. Before the \A...\Z fix this was the sharpest instance of the $-vs-newline gap: a leading space on ledger_signer was already correctly rejected (malformed_input, cn12's sibling case), but a trailing newline slipped the shape check, then vanished under .strip().lower() before the equality compare, and the vector returned valid -- accepting an ill-formed field is not the same failure as accepting an ill-formed field inconsistently by position.
